system.description:
You conceal your aura the way Obfuscate conceals your flesh, projecting any hue you wish - or none at all - to hide the truth of your soul.

Choose one specific aura (or the absence of one) and project it at will. To fashion an alternate aura you must have experience with Aura Perception; without it you may only project no aura at all. The fake aura is considered always active, and you must consciously "switch it off" to let your true aura show. To hold several auras and switch between them, you must purchase Soul Mask multiple times; the first aura created is the default.
system.duration: Passive, ongoing (toggled to reveal true aura)
